comparison.objective: Extract one toilet roll from a packed case by its core and place it upright in a bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Internal-core grasping and single-item extraction without disturbing neighboring compressible rolls.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one roll released upright in bin, remaining rolls acceptably placed, all still for 2 s; removal/loss violations fail under the applicable spec.
comparison.reason: Selective extraction from a packed array does not test granular screening; spec versions differ on whether transient neighbor motion itself is penalized, but both remain clearly distinct.
